card.name: Hypersensitivity and powder-appearance phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside allergy phrases such as 'hypersensitivity' or 'allergic' reactions in warnings, and words in physical-description phrases such as 'appears as a pale yellow powder'.

modes.label: Allergy wording
modes.description: The word 'ensitivity' or 'allergic' just before 'reactions' in warnings about penicillin and beta-lactam allergy.
modes.example: careful inquiry should be made concerning previous hypers<<ensitivity>> reactions to penicillins, cep

modes.label: Appearance of the drug
modes.description: Linking or colour words in descriptions of how a substance looks, such as 'appears as a pale yellow powder'.
modes.example: Brimonidine tartrate appears<< as>> a pale yellow colored powder to wheatish
